spec.query:
SELECT mean("average") AS "Avg", max("max") AS "Max" 
FROM /^GridOLDagEvalCyclesThread($threadNum)$/ 
WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($interval), "host", "measurement" fill(none)

SELECT mean("average") AS "Avg", max("max") AS "Max" ,  mean("count") AS "Max" 
FROM /^GridOLDagEvalCyclesThread($threadNum)$/ 
WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($interval), "host", "measurement" fill(none)

SELECT  mean("count") 
FROM /^GridOLDagCyclesThread($threadNum)$/ 
WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($interval), "host", "measurement" fill(none)

SELECT mean("count") AS "NumGridEvals" 
FROM /^GridOLDagEvalCyclesThread($threadNum)$/ 
WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($interval), "host", "measurement" fill(0)

SELECT CUMULATIVE_SUM(mean("count")) AS "NumGridEvalsCumCount" 
FROM /^GridOLDagEvalCyclesThread($threadNum)$/ 
WHERE ("host" =~ /^$host$/) AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY time($interval), "host", "measurement" fill(none)
